title: Reinforcement learning for optimization of variational quantum circuit architectures
venue: Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 34)
problem_summary: Uses a reinforcement-learning agent to autonomously search the space of possible VQE ansatze, balancing circuit depth against expressivity, demonstrated on estimating the LiH ground-state energy.

components.notes: Intrinsically motivated RL agent incrementally improves accuracy while minimizing circuit depth.

components.family_or_name: RL agent training loop over candidate ansatz architectures

workflow_composition_notes: RL agent proposes ansatz architecture modifications; each candidate is evaluated via a VQE energy estimate, and the RL reward balances accuracy against circuit depth, closing an outer learning loop around the standard VQE inner loop.
